Job Description

Job ID: MJ000249


The Engineering Team at Traveloka is the Innovation, building scalable and high-performance system that power millions of users worldwide. With a relentless focus on scalability, reliability, and performance, we ensure a seamless experience for travelers. Our dedication to excellence and problem-solving makes us instrumental in shaping Traveloka's future as a leader in the digital travel space.


Key Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable infrastructure for Android applications.

2. CI/CD Pipeline: Develop and optimize continuous integration and deployment pipelines for mobile projects.

3. Tools & Automation: Build tools and scripts to automate repetitive tasks and improve R&D efficiency.

4. Monitoring & Diagnostics: Implement monitoring and logging systems to ensure application performance and reliability.

5. Collaboration: Work closely with Dev, QA, and SRE teams to integrate new infrastructure solutions.

6. Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize build performance, app startup time, and runtime performance.

7. Security: Ensure all infrastructure components follow security best practices.

8. Documentation: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and setup guides.


Requirements

1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
